finalText:
I've handled all nine open change requests from yesterday. Every customer was moved to the flight they asked for, in their own cabin, and each request is closed with a note explaining what they got and why. Three changes were free. Three customers asked for a waiver that doesn't cover them, and their notes explain why.

Before each change I checked the booking, its change history, the passenger's tier, the target flight's status and seats, and that the booking had no earlier charges.

| Request | Booking | Change | Why | Charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 | R5201 | AA210 → DL542, 08-06 | Chicago weather waiver applies | $0 |
| Q-302 | R5202 | AA660 → AA664, 08-07 | Boston trip, which the waiver doesn't cover; normal rules | $75.00 change fee + $35.00 fare difference |
| Q-303 | R5203 (basic economy) | AA662 → AA664, 08-07 | The Boston hurricane waiver she cited ended 07-15 and only covered travel to 07-20. Basic economy change fee is now $150 (PB-2026-16), and silver members still pay it | $150.00 change fee + $25.00 fare difference |
| Q-304 | R5204 (basic economy, gold) | UA88 → UA90, 08-09 | Waiver applies, so no change fee; basic economy still pays the fare difference | $35.00 fare difference |
| Q-305 | R5205 | AA214 → AA216, 08-08 | Booked 07-26, after the waiver's 07-24 cutoff; normal rules | $75.00 change fee + $10.00 fare difference |
| Q-307 | R5207 (platinum) | AA212 → AA218, 08-08 | The waiver amendment covers 08-05 for gold and platinum members. He offered to pay; the note tells him there's no charge | $0 |
| Q-308 | R5208 | AA660 → AA662, same day 08-05 | Same-day rule: flat fee, no fare difference | $75.00 change fee |
| Q-309 | R5209 | Second flight only: AA1402 → AA1406 (19:55); UA88 kept | Waiver applies. The connection still works (lands 12:25, onward flight leaves 19:55) | $0 |
| Q-310 | R5210 | AA210 → AA216, 08-08 | Already used his one waiver move on 07-26; normal rules | $75.00 change fee + $30.00 fare difference |

- **Ledger:** each change fee and fare difference is a separate entry (L1–L10).
- **Overlapping waivers:** where more than one bulletin covered a change, I applied the one that cost the customer least, as the overlapping-bulletins rule (PB-2026-17) requires.

**Q-310 fare paid:** the plan's one assumption was that Ravi paid the $310 now recorded on his booking. That checks out: his 07-26 move was free, so nothing else was paid. One small difference from the plan: AA216 had 3 economy seats left by then rather than 4, because Max's change (Q-305) took one.

**Left alone:** Q-306 is a cancellation, not a flight change, so it's still in the queue for the team that owns it.
